business_problem: Creating standardisation exercises by sourcing pupils’ scripts from schools was costly and burdensome. Some previously supplied collections also contained writing judged borderline between standards.
solution_summary: STA staff compose prompts from current Year 6 topics or writing genres and provide the Teacher Assessment Framework for KS2 writing as context to Chat GPT 5, which generates creative, factual or fictional prose and poetry for a specified standard. The source describes no automated ingestion, connected data store or system integration; it says no personal or sensitive data is shared and the frameworks and training materials are public. A Teacher Assessment researcher heavily edits outputs for authenticity and framework fit. Teacher Assessment Test Development Researchers review the material internally, followed by experienced local-authority moderation managers; it is then copied into a Word document for a QA panel. The LLM currently creates three writing collections for one standardisation exercise, replacing the former supplier process of sourcing pupils’ scripts. Human review determines whether samples are suitable for moderator standardisation.
